Family Dispute in Patna: What Legal Issues May Arise?
A family dispute may involve much more than divorce.
Depending upon the facts, proceedings may relate to:
• Divorce
 • Maintenance
 • Child custody
 • Domestic violence
 • Matrimonial cruelty
 • Property disputes between family members
 • Restitution of conjugal rights
 • Permanent alimony
 • Criminal proceedings arising from matrimonial disputes
The correct legal remedy depends upon the relationship, facts, documents, applicable law and stage of proceedings.
For example, maintenance can arise under different statutory frameworks, including Section 144 BNSS in appropriate cases.
Family litigation requires sensitivity, but legal strategy must remain precise and evidence-based.
